name: Dark academia
summary: Old libraries, candlelight, tweed, leather books, Latin and brown-green gloom in a romantic dream of a classical college. It spread on Tumblr and TikTok after 2019 and takes much from The Secret History.

philosophy.core_thesis: Treat study as a dark, romantic rite: books, old stone and candlelight make the learned life feel fated.
design_principles: Set the ground in dark brown (#1E1712) or deep green (#16241C), never in pure black.
Use aged paper (#E9DCC0) for text areas and brass (#B08D57) for rules and highlights.
Pair a high-contrast serif for headings with an old-style serif for text; set headings in small capitals or italic.
Light photographs from one warm source, a candle or a window, at a 4:1 shadow ratio and with a vignette of 20%.
Show objects of study: a stacked book, a quill, a skull, a plaster bust, a Latin line at 12px with 0.2em tracking.
Frame content with a thin 1px brass line and an inner 4px gap, like a book plate.
Add a Roman numeral or a Latin motto in each section head.

layout.grid_mechanics: A centred column of 680px with a 12-column base and 24px gutters; plates and footnotes sit in the margins.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 25% to 35% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Justified or flush-left text with a drop cap; headings centred over a rule.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 2px radius, a double border (1px brass, 4px gap, 1px brass) and an arch top on one hero image.

font_pairings.note: A sharp, high-contrast display serif with a classical text face.
Small capitals with a calm text serif for a book look.
A face from old English printing for a worn page.

hierarchy_rules: Set section heads in small capitals with 0.12em tracking.
Start the first paragraph with a drop cap of 3 lines.

color.palette_structure: Dark brown and forest green with aged paper, brass and a deep burgundy.
color.contrast_rules: Aged paper on study brown holds 12:1; dust holds 6:1; brass carries rules and large headings, burgundy carries fills with paper text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat dark fills with a warm vignette and a 4% paper grain; photographs carry a brown-green tone.
color.light_and_shadow: One warm point source; a glow of 24px blur in #E9B872 at 20%; the shadows stay deep and soft.

materiality.surface_simulation: Leather, aged paper, wood panelling, brass, stone and wax.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px brass line, a 4px gap and a second 1px line on plates; corners with small ornaments.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A shadow of 0 12px 32px at 40% black; no glass and no neon.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Fine outline icons at 24px with 1.25px strokes and square caps; Roman numerals as list markers.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Engravings of books, skulls, moths, busts and arches; a candle flame; a Latin motto in italic.

motion.transition_physics: Slow, candle-like: fades of 500ms; a glow breathes between 18% and 24% at 4s loops.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover warms a link to brass and adds a 1px underline; active state dims the glow.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels learned, brooding and drawn to a private, romantic world of books.

avoid_when: The product needs a light, playful or fast tone.
The audience reads on small screens in bright light.
The page needs high-key, clinical clarity.

modifiers.how: Lift the ground to cream, swap brass for sage and keep the serif.
Switch to a white ground and black serif headings with large margins.
Add ornate borders, dense engraved panels and a blackletter initial.

pack.why: A fine linear set whose thin strokes sit well beside serif type and engravings.

ground.why: Dark academia stands on a dark, paper-like ground, the page of an old book in low light.
